name: The Hotel Hershey
description: The Hotel Hershey is the luxury resort in the hills above Hersheypark, built by Milton S. Hershey and opened in 1933. Its Mediterranean-style building has formal gardens, a spa, multiple restaurants and a pool, and it is an Official Resort of Hersheypark with perks such as ticket discounts and extra park hours. A calm, elegant base for couples and families who want a special stay.

name: Hershey Lodge
description: Hershey Lodge is a large, family-friendly resort a short distance from Hersheypark, with indoor and outdoor pools, several restaurants, a chocolate-themed shop and activities for children. It is an Official Resort of Hersheypark, so guests get perks such as ticket discounts and extra park hours, and a good-value base for a family trip.

name: Hershey Inn & Suites
description: Hershey Inn & Suites is the newest Official Resort of Hersheypark, new for 2026. It is designed for families who want a modern, convenient base close to the park, with guest perks such as ticket discounts and extra park hours. Check the official site for the latest room types, amenities and opening details.

name: Hersheypark Camping Resort
description: Hersheypark Camping Resort is the outdoor option among the Official Resorts of Hersheypark, with campsites for tents and RVs and cabins for guests who want a nature-based stay near the park. Camping guests get perks such as ticket discounts and extra park hours. Facilities and seasonal dates vary, so check the official site before booking.
